title: פרס נובל שנולד מנייר דבק ועיפרון
summary: Graphene: Geim & Novoselov's 'Friday night experiments' at Manchester — tape retrieved from the bin (Shklyarevskii's idea) peeled graphite down to one carbon layer (Science, Oct 2004; Nobel 2010; Geim's 2000 Ig Nobel frog); 1 mm graphite ≈ 3 million layers of 0.335 nm, each peel halves → 22 peels (2^22); honeycomb: strong in-plane bonds vs weak interlayer grip (why pencils write, why tape works); ~100× steel at equal thickness, 2.3% light absorption, 0.76 mg/m² (a cat-holding hammock ≈ a whisker; a football pitch ≈ one sheet of paper); Bistritzer (Israeli) & MacDonald's 2011 magic angle ~1.1°, MIT 2018 superconductivity, Wolf Prize 2020, Ilani/Weizmann; maths: repeated halving & powers of 2, mm→nm, area × mass-per-area, moiré period.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (3 rounds) — nits left: the figure's 'רוחב התמונה' label sits ~5 px from the phone edge; the 'עובי הפתית' plate touches the 'עיפרון' plate by a few canvas px on phones; the floating Arto button can cover left-edge canvas labels on phones (template); the review copy doesn't declare the sample capability, so Arto falls back there (template)
